trainer.title: Ear & fretboard trainer
trainer.toolDescription: Find notes on the fretboard against the clock, and train your ear on intervals and chord qualities.

about.fretboard: A note and a string are shown. Find the note on that string by tapping the fretboard, or by playing it on your instrument.
about.interval: Two notes play one after the other. Name the interval between them, or play the second note on your instrument.
about.chord: A chord plays. Name its quality: major, minor, seventh and so on, or play the chord back on your instrument.

trainer.micHint: Fretbook listens through your microphone. Wait for the sound to finish before you play.
trainer.logged: This practice time is in your practice log.

exercises.toolDescription: Generate scales, arpeggios, finger drills, chord-change and bass practice, ready to play along with.
exercises.heading: Exercises
exercises.subtitle: Build a practice exercise from theory, preview the tab, and save it to your library to play it like any song.
exercises.chordsHelp: Two to four chords, such as G C D Em.
exercises.bassChordsHelp: Up to eight chords, one bar each, such as E7 A7 E7 B7.

pentatonicBox.title: A minor pentatonic box
pentatonicBox.description: The first box of the minor pentatonic scale, up and down in eighth notes.

majorOctave.title: C major octave
majorOctave.description: One octave of C major in the C shape.

dorianTriplets.title: D Dorian triplets
dorianTriplets.description: Two octaves of D Dorian in triplets.

minorSeventhArpeggio.title: Am7 arpeggio
minorSeventhArpeggio.description: An A minor seventh arpeggio over two octaves.

spiderWarmUp.title: Spider warm-up
spiderWarmUp.description: 1-2-3-4 across every string from the fifth fret.

spiderCrawl.title: Spider crawl
spiderCrawl.description: 1-3-2-4, moving up a fret each pass.

openChordChanges.title: Open chord changes
openChordChanges.description: G, C, D and Em, four beats each.

folkStrum.title: Folk strumming
folkStrum.description: Am, F, C and G with a folk strumming pattern.

rootFifthOctave.title: Root-fifth-octave
rootFifthOctave.description: A bass line over C, G, Am and F.

walkingBlues.title: Walking blues bass
walkingBlues.description: A walking line over E7, A7, E7 and B7.

errors.noNotes: That position has too few notes of this scale or chord. Try another position or a longer range.
errors.badChord: "{chord}" is not a chord Fretbook knows.
errors.noVoicing: There is no playable shape for {chord} on this instrument.
errors.tooHigh: The drill runs past the end of the neck. Start lower or use fewer shifts.
errors.outOfRange: A note falls outside this instrument's range.

offline.indicatorHint: Songs and setlists saved on this device still work. Edits are sent when you are back online.
offline.makeHint: Keep this on the device so it opens with no network
offline.removeHint: Remove the copy kept on this device
offline.failed: Could not remove it. Try again.
offline.saveFailed: Could not save it for offline use. Check your connection and try again.
offline.opFailed: A change made offline could not be saved: {message}
offline.conflict: “{title}” was changed somewhere else, so your offline edits were not saved.
offline.syncFailed: Your offline edits to “{title}” could not be saved: {message}

rhythm.toolDescription: Tap, press Space or strum a muted string along with a click and see whether you rush or drag.
rhythm.intro: Pick a pattern, then play it along with the click after a one-bar count-in. The click marks the beats only, so you have to feel the subdivisions yourself.
rhythm.useMic: Listen with the microphone (strum muted strings)
rhythm.noCalibration: No latency calibration yet. Run the calibration in Settings for more accurate microphone timing.
rhythm.calibrated: Microphone timing corrected by {ms} ms of calibrated latency.
rhythm.tripletNote: Triplets: three even hits to each beat.
rhythm.rushing: You rush: you tend to play ahead of the click.
rhythm.dragging: You drag: you tend to play behind the click.
rhythm.steady: Steady: your hits sit on the click.
rhythm.noHits: No hits were heard. Tap, press Space or strum along with the click.
rhythm.histogram: Histogram of timing errors in milliseconds
rhythm.histogramHint: Bars to the left are early hits, bars to the right are late ones (milliseconds).
rhythm.songLoadFailed: Could not load that song's bars.
rhythm.songEmpty: No bars in this track could be turned into a rhythm to practise.

autoSync.buttonHint: Estimate the bar marks from the audio
autoSync.title: Auto-sync
autoSync.subtitle: Estimate where each bar starts by listening to the beat in the audio.
autoSync.tracking: Finding the beats and matching them to the bars
autoSync.noResult: The estimate finished without a result.
autoSync.timeout: The estimate took too long. Try again.
autoSync.summary: {marks} bar marks found, with {confidence}% confidence. The audio runs at about {bpm} BPM.
autoSync.check: Worth checking after you accept: bars {bars}.
autoSync.allClear: Every mark sits on a clear beat.
autoSync.startHint: Does the recording start with the tab's first bar? If it has an intro or count-in the tab lacks, or begins partway through the song, say where the music starts. Leave both as they are otherwise.
autoSync.musicTime: At this time in the audio
autoSync.musicTimeInvalid: Enter seconds (12.5) or minutes and seconds (0:12).
autoSync.previewHint: Plays the audio with a click on each beat, and a higher click on the first beat of each bar. If the clicks line up with the music, accept.
autoSync.acceptHint: After accepting, fix any mark that is off with the tap, nudge and clear buttons, as before.

stems.title: Stems
stems.hint: Separate the recording into its parts to mute the bass or solo the guitar.
stems.separateHint: Takes a few minutes on a GPU, much longer on a CPU. The first run downloads the model.
stems.usingHint: The recording plays as its separate parts.
stems.separating: Separating the stems (slow without a GPU)
stems.timeout: Separating took too long. Try again.
stems.failed: The stems could not be made.
stems.noWorker: Stem separation needs the job worker with Demucs installed. See the self-hosting guide.

transcribe.title: Transcribe audio into tab
transcribe.buttonHint: Transcribe the recording into a draft tab track
transcribe.hint: Transcribe polyphonic notes from the recording into a new tab track with automatic fingering and sync marks.
transcribe.timeout: Transcription took too long. Try again.

youtubeAudio.label: Add audio from a YouTube link
youtubeAudio.timeout: The download took too long. Try again later.

lessons.heading: Lessons
lessons.subtitle: Courses for guitar and bass. Each lesson opens the next, and your progress is saved.
lessons.empty: There are no courses yet. An administrator can add some, or drop a lesson pack into the lessons folder.
lessons.passScore: Play it with a score of at least {score}%.
lessons.passScoreBpm: Play it with a score of at least {score}% at {bpm} BPM or faster.
lessons.passWait: Play it through in wait mode.
lessons.passNone: Mark the lesson as done when you are happy with it.
lessons.checkHelp: Practise the song, then check. Your practice log is searched for a run that meets the goal.
lessons.passed: Passed! The next lesson is open.
lessons.notYet: Not there yet. Keep practising and try again.
lessons.nextLocked: Pass this lesson to unlock the next one.
lessons.playExercise: Play the exercise in wait mode
lessons.editorHelp: Write Markdown with a front matter header. Blocks like chords and exercises go in fenced code.
lessons.courseEditorHelp: A course file names the track, the levels and any courses to finish first.
lessons.builtinNote: This is a built-in lesson. Saving keeps your version as a copy.
lessons.confirmDeleteLesson: Delete this lesson? A built-in lesson it replaced comes back.

handsFree.pedalHint: A Bluetooth pedal sends ordinary keys. Choose what each one does in the player and on chord sheets. “Keep” leaves a key to its normal job.

firstRun.title: Welcome to Fretbook
firstRun.subtitle: Your library is empty. Pick a place to start; you can come back to any of these later.
firstRun.importBody: Paste a Songsterr, Ultimate Guitar or YouTube link, drop a Guitar Pro, MusicXML, MIDI or ChordPro file or a whole folder, paste a text tab, or start a blank tab.
firstRun.demoBody: Three original songs: a bass tab with audio and sync, a guitar tab and a chord sheet. Remove them any time in Settings.
firstRun.instrumentBody: New tabs, added parts and imports start on this instrument.
firstRun.tunerBody: Check your tuning with the microphone before you play.
firstRun.courseBody: A short beginner course for your instrument, with lessons you can play along to.

demo.heading: Demo songs
demo.hint: Three original songs that come with Fretbook. Removing them never touches your own songs.
demo.confirmRemove: Remove the demo songs from your library?
demo.banner: This is a read-only demo. Look around and play; changes are not saved, and the library resets every night.

lessonRun.unavailable: This lesson could not be loaded, so results from here are not reported.
lessonRun.askWait: Play the whole song through in wait mode, from the first note, to pass this lesson.
lessonRun.askScore: Play the whole song in scored mode with a score of at least {score}%.
lessonRun.askScoreBpm: Play the whole song in scored mode with a score of at least {score}% at {bpm} BPM or faster.
lessonRun.noCondition: This lesson is marked as done on its own page.
lessonRun.songBound: This lesson is checked against your practice log: play its song, then press Check my practice on the lesson page.
lessonRun.error: The result could not be saved to the lesson. Check your connection and play it again.
lessonRun.import: Import a song to practise on

metadata.heading: Details
metadata.notesHint: Your own notes. Markdown works: **bold**, *italic*, lists and links.
metadata.coverHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Without one, the app draws a cover.
metadata.lookupHint: Sends the artist and title to MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive to fill in an empty album, year and cover.

storage.heading: Storage per user
storage.hint: Database rows are a user's songs, setlists, practice log, lesson progress, calibrations and inbox files. Media is audio, stems, covers and kept uploads.
storage.orphansNone: Every file in the media folder belongs to a song.

orphansFound.one: {count} file ({size}) in the media folder belongs to no song.
orphansFound.other: {count} files ({size}) in the media folder belong to no song.

storage.orphansHint: Files saved in the last hour are left alone.
storage.confirmCleanup: Delete the orphaned media files? This cannot be undone.

jobs.heading: Job queue
jobs.hint: Imports and other background work of every user. Only jobs still waiting in the queue can be cancelled.
jobs.workersHint: Separate worker processes report in every few seconds. The web server runs the other kinds itself.

llm.hint: Used to review auto-generated tabs and write easier versions of a song.
